Thanks Grace — quick clarifications so we can route to procurement/security: 

1) SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report (testing period and report date), plus a bridge letter if the report is more than 12 months old. The report should include the testing period end date (we typically ask for period ending 2027-12-31 or later).
2) Bridge letter: please confirm whether the bridge letter references subprocessors and whether it includes any attestations about data residency.
3) GDPR/HIPAA: Medivance is evaluating both. Please confirm if Redwood processes PHI and whether you can sign a HIPAA BAA; if not a BAA, a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with standard HIPAA/GDPR clauses will help.

I've attached our VSQ — if you could return answers in the spreadsheet or let me know who on your side will own it, that would be ideal. Procurement is targeting an initial review by end of week; if you can't make the full report available, a temporary attestation + bridge letter will suffice for the first pass.

Files attached: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Medivance_v1.xlsx

Best,

- Redaction policy: we do not redact the control testing sections by default. We do require an access agreement for the raw attachments (standard NDA + limited-use clause). For procurement-first-pass, the bridge letter and a summary system description are usually acceptable.
- HIPAA/DPA: Redwood is not currently a HIPAA-covered entity and does not sign BAAs as a routine customer contract. We can sign a DPA with HIPAA-specific obligations (appropriate technical/organizational safeguards) and provide a written statement about PHI handling. I've prepared a standard DPA draft and initiated a DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/Redwood/DPA-RDW-1229.

ETA: portal invite and files are live now. If Medivance needs expanded access (downloadable full report), we'll require a countersigned access agreement; Marcus will coordinate execution.
